giftTips.artsAndCrafts: Sofinka loves arts and crafts. Colored paper, craft kits, stencils, glitter and markers disappear at lightning speed in our house. ✂️✨
giftTips.sensoryPlay: She also loves modeling clay, kinetic sand, cookie cutters and textured rollers.
giftTips.booksAndColoring: Coloring books, stickers and storybooks are always a hit – especially those with kittens, princesses and superheroes.
giftTips.clothes: Pretty clothes in pink, purple or rainbow colors are always welcome. Size 116 and up.
giftTips.accessories: No princess is complete without accessories. 👑 Headbands, sunglasses, hair clips, hair ties, hair extensions, bracelets and handbags are always a great choice.
giftTips.music: In her free time, she transforms into a talented little musician. 🎵🎵🎵
giftTips.kitchen: A moment later she's cooking or baking delicious treats and happily selling them to us. 🍕🧁
giftTips.police: Sometimes she's a brave police officer chasing thieves with sirens blaring and a toy pistol in hand.
giftTips.doctor: Other times she becomes a doctor, taking great care of her stuffed animals (and her little brother). 🩺
giftTips.building: She loves building little houses, forts and all kinds of secret hideouts.
giftTips.minecraftMagnetTiles: Her favorite building toys are magnetic construction sets inspired by Minecraft.
giftTips.magneticTiles: She also loves magnetic tiles that look like colorful stained glass windows.
giftTips.lego: And of course, you can never go wrong with LEGO Classic or Duplo. 🧱
giftTips.favoriteShows: Her current favorites are Spidey, Iron Friends, Miraculous Ladybug, Bluey and Gabby's Dollhouse.
giftTips.astrobot: And the biggest hit of all? 🔥 Astro Bot on the PS5, which we love playing together.
